One important point missing from this video is that each type of cancer is different—with different causes, progressions, and treatments. While it’s true that healthy habits like good nutrition, exercise, and sleep help reduce risk, the main cause of many cancers is random mutations in our cells, which can happen regardless of lifestyle.

It’s important to recognize that lifestyle factors can lower risk but cannot guarantee prevention. Oversimplifying cancer causes can mislead people and create false hope. Let’s keep the conversation honest and science-based!
